questions.subject: ALGEBRA_I
questions.learningObjective: rationalise a denominator containing a square root
questions.stem: Which expression is equivalent to 1 divided by the square root of 2?

options.misconception: leaves the radical in the denominator
multiplies numerator and denominator by the wrong factor
doubles the numerator without rationalising

questions.explanation: Multiply numerator and denominator by the square root of 2, giving sqrt(2) over 2. The trap is stopping before simplifying, because 1 over sqrt(2) is correct but not rationalised, and the other options misapply the multiplication.
questions.hint: Multiply top and bottom by the radical.
